newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end lower, led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end lower, led by blue chips.

text.p: Portuguese shares closed lower with losses in some heavily weighted blue chips dragging the whole index down and a weak dollar keeping foreign investors away.
*PSI20 May futures were lower at 6,123 points after 6,134 at the previous close.
*BTA dropped 139 escudos to 2,571 on volume of 232,839 as the stock went ex-dividend. The 129 escudo per share pay-out is due on Thursday.
*Inapa was most heavily traded with volume of 290,842 shares, a movement dealers attributed to portfolio shuffling ahead of its dividend pay-out. The stock ended flat at 5,350 escudos.
*Portucel Industrial shed 1 escudo to finish at 1,114 with 268,570 shares traded.
*Colep bucked the trend, ending up 34 esc at 2,369 on turnover of 77,390 after the metal and packaging business announced it was back in profit in the first quarter.
